heading: Wi-Fi observations
body: BSSIDScan records Wi-Fi events and network identifiers that iOS makes available to the app. These records are stored in an encrypted database on your device. The developer does not receive your Wi-Fi history.

heading: Analytics and advertising
body: The app has no advertising or in-app analytics SDK and does not send usage data or crash reports to a developer-operated service. Apple may handle device diagnostics according to your Apple settings.

heading: Export
body: You choose when to export observations as JSON or Markdown and where to save or share them. Network identifiers in exported files may be sensitive; review a file before sharing it.

heading: Contact
body: If you email us for support, we receive your message and email address so we can reply. For privacy questions, email xnuapp@gmail.com. This policy was updated September 27, 2026.
